facts.text: Deborah has cats instead of dogs because she does not like dogs.

evidence.quote: I don't like dogs, that's why I have cats.

facts.text: Deborah takes her pets out for a run in the park every morning and evening.

evidence.quote: I make sure to take them out for a run in the park every morning and evening.

facts.text: Deborah's pets are sitting on a couch with a blanket in a photograph.

evidence.quote: I haven't introduced you to my pets yet! I don't like dogs, that's why I have cats. [image: a photography of two cats sitting on a couch with a blanket]
